A geo regulation activity to delimit and assert control over geographical spaces through regulations
A group party is any number of parties, together forming a distinct entity, with each party registere
Land represents any  spatial extent to be covered by rights, restrictions and responsibilities, encompassing the wet and dry parts of the Earth surface, including all space above and below
land administration is the process of determining, recording and disseminating information about the relationship between people and land
A party represents a  person or organization that plays a role in any land administration process
A party member is a party registered and identified as a constituent of a group party

A profile is the set of one or more base standards or subsets of base standards, and, where applicable, the identification of chosen clauses, classes, options and parameters of those base standards, that are necessary for accomplishing a particular function
A register is a set of files containing identifiers assigned to items with descriptions of the associated items
A registry is an  information system on which a register is maintained
A regulation is a document providing binding legislative rules, that is adopted by an authority

A source is a  document providing legal and/or administrative facts on which the land administration object is based

Competency Question / Natural language: Spatial units may be grouped into as spatial unit groups. Spatial unit groups can be further grouped into larger spatial unit groups. This is realized by an aggregation relationship of  SpatialUnitGroup onto itself.
